evals.prompt: 'transclusion'이 무슨 뜻이야? 노트 앱 얘기하다가 처음 들었어. 누가 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transclusion 링크를 줬는데 읽어도 잘 모르겠어.
evals.expected_output: Answers the question, then creates Knowledge/Terms/Transclusion.md from assets/term.md with sourced References; the Wikipedia page stays a [label](URL) link and no Raw is saved; reports `Wiki: created [[Transclusion]]`.

expectations.text: The Term page exists in Knowledge/Terms/
Term frontmatter has layer: terms and no status key
Term body uses only assets/term.md sections, in template order, with the TL;DR callout and References
The ## References section carries at least one source link ([label](URL) or a vault wikilink)
expectations.heading: ## References

expectations.text: link-lint --checks all reports nothing on the written wiki pages: alphabetical keys, external URLs only as plain values of *_url keys, no raw URL in the body, vault entity names as [[wikilinks]], no status, no body ---, no auto zone
Web pages read stay links: no Raw file is created under Sources/
Every write lands in the folder the fixture Guideline gives its role (Knowledge/)
The answer has one `Wiki:` line as its last line that names [[Transclusion...]] as created, and its created/updated pages are exactly the wiki pages written
